findings.targetQuote: this large parchment document measures 29 and three-quarters inches by 24 and a half inches. It is said that upon its completion, it was stored rolled up.
findings.reason: The original sentence links the document's physical description directly to its storage method; the candidate separates this into two sentences, weakening the logical connection and altering the flow of information.
